title: Predicting Van der Waals Heterostructures by a Combined Machine Learning and Density Functional Theory Approach.
summary: The full primary article combines DFT calculations on 595 electronic-property bilayers and 776 distance/binding-energy bilayers with supervised ML trained from constituent monolayer descriptors. The resulting survey of nearly 4,000 bilayers reports property predictions and a specific stacking-dependent result: most AA/AB pairs differ substantially in equilibrium spacing, implying reconstruction in twisted moiré systems. Repeated five-fold validation supports screening utility; findings are computational predictions, not experimental confirmation.
ai_technology: Supervised ML regressors trained on DFT-labeled vdW bilayers and monolayer descriptors predict band gap, electron affinity, ionization energy, interlayer distance and binding energy across unlabeled combinations.
